tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List issues in the user's Linear workspace. For my issues, use "me" as the assignee.

limit.description: The number of results to return (Max is 250)

orderBy.description: The order in which to return results

query.description: Search for content in the issue title or description

team.description: The team name or ID to filter by

state.description: The state name or ID to filter by

cycle.description: The cycle name or ID to filter by

label.description: A label name or ID to filter by

assignee.description: The assignee to filter by (User ID, name, email, or "me")

delegate.description: An agent name or ID to filter by

project.description: The project name or ID to filter by

parentId.description: The parent issue ID to filter by

createdAt.description: Return only issues created on or after this ISO-8601 date-time or duration. e.g. -P1D to get issues created in the last day

updatedAt.description: Return only issues updated on or after this ISO-8601 date-time or duration. e.g. -P1D to get issues updated in the last day

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about an issue by ID, including attachments and git branch name

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments for a specific Linear issue

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects in the user's Linear workspace

limit.description: The number of results to return (Max is 250)

orderBy.description: The order in which to return results

query.description: Search for content in the project name

state.description: The state name or ID to filter by

initiative.description: The initiative name or ID to filter by

team.description: The team name or ID to filter by

member.description: A team member to filter by (User ID, name, email, or "me")

createdAt.description: Return only projects created on or after this ISO-8601 date-time or duration. e.g. -P1D to get projects created in the last day

updatedAt.description: Return only projects updated on or after this ISO-8601 date-time or duration. e.g. -P1D to get projects updated in the last day

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Retrieve details of a specific project in Linear

query.description: The ID or name of the project to retrieve

tools.name: list_issue_statuses
tools.description: List available issue statuses in a Linear team
